title: Federal consumer complaint routes
facts: The appropriate federal complaint channel depends on the problem rather than there being one agency for every consumer dispute.
CFPB handles complaints involving many financial products and services such as credit reporting, debt collection, mortgages, bank accounts and consumer loans.
FTC ReportFraud accepts reports involving scams, fraud and many unfair or deceptive business practices.
FCC handles communications issues including unwanted calls and texts, while state attorneys general and specialized federal or state regulators can also be relevant.
